findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 19 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 78 questions numbered 1-78; by section: 19.1 4, 19.2 5, 19.3 4, 19.4 19, 19.5 7, 19.6 3, 19.7 13, 19.8 6, 19.9 1, 19.9.1 14, 19.10 2.

Covers sections 19.1-19.10 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small formula numericals (empirical/molecular formula, 2ⁿ) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise (no homolytic/heterolytic or racemic/meso difference, no pent-2-ene, no tartaric-acid 'why inactive'). Book corrections followed (KCN, alkanes vs alcohols, alphabetical prefixes, NH in secondary amines, ethanamide C₂H₅NO, seven reaction types, 2-bromopropane, ethene, +δ carbon in bromoethane, p orbitals, thalidomide).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
